_note: All 8 VSLR1 beacon SKUs from the ground-truth sku_map. This is a separate product family from the Vision SLR lightbar (VSLR46/53/60, see vision-slr-configurator.json) per the master knowledge doc's discrepancy report — VSLR1 prefix, Fire vertical only. LED color and dome (Matching vs Clear) are read directly from the sku_map's confirmed fields. Structured after valor-configurator.json. Do NOT invent prices; resolved at runtime from shopify-variant-index.json.
